column1: # Which Record Atlas region (the contract's region ids) each place string this archive prints beside a date on a person's page belongs to, for the
# 'at the time' notes (site/src/pages/people/[slug].astro, kit/docs/era-notes.md). One row per place string AS PRINTED: the place of each dated fact of every
# register person who is not living, and the place of a born / died line in the English line (date, then one place). A region of '-' means: looked at, and
# no Atlas region covers it (or the string is not one place, or a regime note would be wrong or glib there), so no note. A new place string fails
# tools/build-era.py --check until it is decided here. Mapped by hand against the Atlas's regions; erasnap.py then refuses any town whose point
# (data/era/towns.tsv, column 4 here names the town) falls in a DIFFERENT region's ring, or within 15 km of its own region's edge.
# ONE CAVEAT the table cannot carry, because a region's eras are region-wide: a few Atlas eras describe only PART of their region (east-prussia 1945:
# Russia / Poland / Lithuania; galicia 1945: Poland west of the San, Ukraine east; silesia 1918: divided; west-prussia 1920: the Corridor).
# tools/build-era.py --check fails if a mapped place has a dated event in one of those eras, so a person looks at it before a note can say it.
